recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the seed's expanded all-name-resource clarification without changing search expressions or broadening behavior beyond the approved FHIR-5899 rule.
issue_request: FHIR-5899 was a Published FHIR-core Patient change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked for the Patient "name" search parameter to include HumanName.text, and the final PA resolution expanded the clarification to Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and Person name search parameters.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify SVN revision 9027 as the applied change. In git history this is bd0f9cdf485f62a9fc72955669fbd73479777edd, which inserted the HumanName string-field wording, including text, into the then-active search descriptions for the affected resources. That original wording also introduced the inherited "give" typo and duplicate "suffix" entries.
additional_context: The current build uses active resource folders for Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and Person. Patient-name was later corrected by e6a9a72025eeda3b1b5e3ee29af2c350f5809762 while applying FHIR-25446, and FHIR-20003/FHIR-39454 confirm the Patient-specific typo cleanup is already represented on the combined branch. Direct Confluence and Zulip searches for FHIR-5899 found no contrary community decision.
reconciliation: Changed only the active Practitioner-name, RelatedPerson-name, and Person-name SearchParameter descriptions from "family, give, prefix, suffix, suffix, and/or text" to "family, given, prefix, suffix, and/or text". Patient-name already had the corrected wording and was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/practitioner/bundle-Practitioner-search-params.xml: corrected Practitioner-name HumanName field list from give/duplicate suffix to given/single suffix.
source/relatedperson/bundle-RelatedPerson-search-params.xml: corrected RelatedPerson-name HumanName field list from give/duplicate suffix to given/single suffix.
source/person/bundle-Person-search-params.xml: corrected Person-name HumanName field list from give/duplicate suffix to given/single suffix.
